notes: Read all 3 source lines line by line; the file is a re-export barrel, so each export name is preserved one-for-one in the native barrel and resolves to a dedicated React Native sibling file (data-display/charts barrel precedent), with no DOM/Recharts/Leaflet/framer-motion/react-router/lucide imports in native output.

Line 1 (export {VehicleHeroCard, type VehicleHeroCardProps} from './VehicleHeroCard') covered by new VehicleHeroCard.tsx: photo (RN Image), identity row (AppText name + native StatusBadge + inline model pill), four RadialGauges (battery/range/inside/outside) and an 8-cell StatCard grid from the parity charts/data-display barrels, and Details/Commands/Live-Map actions ported from react-router <Link to=...> to Pressables calling an optional onNavigate(path) with the identical in-app paths (/vehicles/:id, /vehicles/:id/commands, /vehicles/:id/map). SI meters/°C are converted to the settings-derived display unit exactly as web (convertDistanceFromSI/convertTempFromSI + useFormatPrefs); rangeMax/tempMax and the battery>20 colour threshold are preserved.

Line 2 (export {VehicleTwin, type VehicleTwinProps, type VehicleTwinSize} from './VehicleTwin') covered by new VehicleTwin.tsx. The web component is a ~1300-line layered SVG (viewBox, dozens of path/circle/ellipse/linearGradient nodes) with framer-motion keyframes and lucide icons; apps/native ships NO react-native-svg, framer-motion or lucide-react, so per the native-safe rule the pixel-faithful SVG is not reproduced. Preserved instead: the exact VehicleTwinProps surface (VehicleTwinState + size/interactive/driveIn/className/style/vehicleId/exteriorColor/paint), VehicleTwinSize = keyof SIZE_MAP, the SIZE_MAP {sm:300,md:440,lg:560} + ASPECT_RATIO (220/560) dimension math, the paint-resolution precedence (paint prop > useVehiclePaint override+inference > FALLBACK_PAINT) with the same colorSource = exteriorColor ?? non-empty vehicleColor, a finite Animated translate+fade drive-in, and a status-chip readout of EVERY telemetry overlay the SVG draws (lock always; sentry/charging/charge-port/driving/doors/windows/frunk/trunk/headlights/hazards/turn-signal/driver-seat conditionally) over a stylised car painted in the resolved swatch. The infinite wheel-spin / charging-underglow pulse loops are intentionally omitted to stay native-safe (no leaked timers under --detectOpenHandles).

Line 3 (export {VehiclePaintPicker, type VehiclePaintPickerProps} from './VehiclePaintPicker') covered by new VehiclePaintPicker.tsx: <div role=radiogroup> of <button role=radio> swatches -> View accessibilityRole=radiogroup of Pressable accessibilityRole=radio swatches with accessibilityState.selected, the SVG checkmark -> inline '\u2713' glyph, VisuallyHidden label reused from the native a11y barrel, aria-live current label -> accessibilityLiveRegion=polite, and the conditional Reset action. Behaviour (override>inferred>fallback, reset, isOverridden, set-to-inferred clears override) is preserved.

Supporting dependency ports created alongside the barrel (none existed in native): _vehicleColors.ts (verbatim port of web lib/vehicleColors.ts — PAINT_PALETTES/PAINT_PALETTE_LIST/FALLBACK_PAINT/PaintPalette/PaintPaletteId/inferPaintFromTesla/isPaintPaletteId/buildColorMap), _vehicleState.ts (the render-facing DoorStates/WindowState/TurnSignalState/VehicleTwinState types from web lib/vehicleState.ts), and useVehiclePaint.ts (native-safe port of web hooks/useVehiclePaint.ts — same public API + same in-process notify channel for picker<->twin sync, but the localStorage/storage-event/BroadcastChannel persistence is replaced by a module-level in-memory override store; override is session-local, the same graceful degradation web documents for storage-unavailable environments). i18n t(key,fallback[,vars]) is the inlined useNativeTranslationFallback used elsewhere in the parity tree, returning the English fallback copy with {{name}} interpolation support.
